name: VBazaar Look
brief: A shop photo that sells: bright and clean, true colours a little richer, crisp contours, glass and gloss catching the light, every product standing off its background. Only the camera's own pixels are adjusted, the same way for every pixel. Nothing is drawn, added, removed or guessed: a word that cannot be read before cannot be read after, and no product, label, brand or price ever changes.
